title: My Free Time
text:
I like free time very much. On Saturday I go to the park with my friend Tom. We play football for two hours. Then we eat ice cream.

On Sunday I stay at home. I read books and draw pictures. My favorite book is about animals. In the evening I watch a film with my family.

questions.text: Who does the speaker go to the park with on Saturday?
What does the speaker do on Sunday?
How does the speaker probably feel about free time?

options: Someone who enjoys friends and family
Someone who does not like books

living things such as dogs, cats or birds
to make a picture with a pencil or pen

paragraph_translations: Я дуже люблю вільний час. У суботу я ходжу в парк зі своїм другом Томом. Ми граємо у футбол дві години. Потім ми їмо морозиво.
У неділю я залишаюся вдома. Я читаю книжки і малюю картинки. Моя улюблена книжка про тварин. Увечері я дивлюся фільм із родиною.
